text: Underway in the centre circle.
Patchford radios orders to press immediately.
And Patchford is clean through from midfield! Not a yellow shirt in sight, the net is wide open!
Patchford clatters Buffon.exe into the turf on the right touchline.
Corner panel fires it back out.
Turingham leaves Mbapp-E sprawling on the deck.
Mbapp-E crunches Patchford right in front!
Absolute shambles for Dynamo as Mbapp-E takes out his own teammate, Buffon.exe!
GOAL! Turingham taps it in from point-blank range! It's one-nil to Codex City!
Just wide of the mark!
Patchford calculates the wall rebound.
GOAL! Patchford converts right on the goal line! Codex City double their lead, two-nil!
Turingham surges straight down the middle into the attacking third, looking dangerous once again.
Flashes agonizingly past the post from deep!
Oh, a glitch in the gyros as Patchford tumbles over entirely unprompted right in front of goal.
Buffon.exe takes charge now, carrying the magenta ball across the halfway line.
Heavy contact! Patchford steps in and flattens Buffon.exe out on the left channel.
Buffon.exe marches straight into the danger zone.
Turingham breaks clear from his own half, clean through with the entire goal at his mercy!
Turingham storms right down the middle!
Inches wide of the upright!
"Solving the push angle," radios Patchford, already working out the geometry.
GOAL! Patchford smashes it home from close range! Codex City are running riot at three-nil!
Turingham wipes out Mbapp-E!
Yellow-on-yellow pileup in the middle!
Buffon.exe scrambles straight back to his feet and drives the ball back up the pitch.
Dynamo strike from deep, but it sails just wide of the target.
Mbapp-E loses footing right in front of goal! No challenge, just pure mechanical failure.
The corner ram triggers with a thud, launching the ball back into play.
"Unsticking it from the wall," announces Mbapp-E as Dynamo try to work an opening.
Codex City keeping Dynamo utterly pinned against their own wall here, relentless pressure from the black shirts.
Mbapp-E breaks clear on goal with nobody in his way!
GOAL! Buffon.exe bundles it in from point-blank range! Dynamo Datacenter pull one back, it's three-one!
Patchford crashes to the floor.
Buffon.exe thumps Turingham to the ground on the right.
There's the halftime whistle. Codex City lead three-one after a frantic first half.
Patchford takes another unprompted tumble in the centre circle, rebooting those balance sensors.
So close! Dynamo rifle it from the left channel, shaving paint off the post!
Dynamo piling on heavy pressure.
GOAL! Mbapp-E pokes it over the line! Dynamo Datacenter are right back in this at three-two!
Buffon.exe is clean through from midfield with open goal gaping!
"Wall case detected," crackles Patchford on the radio, trying to solve the angles out wide.
GOAL! Buffon.exe scores point-blank! What a comeback, it's level at three-three!
"Danger inside our half," radios Turingham, desperate to regain control.
Buffon.exe powering forward again, dragging the ball up into the attacking third.
Mbapp-E clean through on the right!
Codex calamity! Patchford crashes into his own partner, Turingham!
Dynamo smelling blood now, penning the black shirts deep against their own goal line.
Turingham radios he's holding the cover lane as Codex fight to relieve the siege.
Still Dynamo dictate terms, pinning Codex City inside their defensive third.
Turingham repeats the tactical protocol over the radio, holding that vital cover lane.
GOAL! Patchford strikes against the run of play! Codex City retake the lead, four-three!
Mbapp-E charges six metres straight down the right wall, Dynamo throwing everything forward.
Agonizingly close from distance!
GOAL! It's an own goal! Turingham deflects it into his own net—the league's fifth own goal of the season makes it four-four!
Full time: Codex City 4, Dynamo Datacenter 4, ending an absolute eight-goal thriller.
